title: Runs manifest
description: One row per run. A run is one coherent execution unit (roughly one post_run_report.md's worth). It OWNS no metrics and no per-pass config: passes carry the generation config + cost, conditions carry the metrics. The run carries study grouping tags, corpus/GT/grid context, and a human-designated headline pointer. Generator-written (generator-as-only-writer); humans edit only the headline_condition_id and headline_rationale.

schema_version.description: Manifest FORMAT version (distinct from the generator's extractor_version in each row's provenance).

run_id.description: Stable flat slug (primary key). NO slashes — a slash would re-encode the directory path and re-introduce the fragility this design removes. Seeded from the leaf directory name; group-prefixed only where the bare leaf is not globally unique (e.g. retest-phase2a). Assigned once, NEVER changes.

directory_path.description: MUTABLE. Current location under outputs/. The H11 reorganisation edits THIS field (one per moved run); run_id and every foreign key / lineage reference survive untouched. Authoritative location lives in the run registry.

primary_hypothesis.description: The main study this run was executed for — the clean single-value grouping for the common query. Controlled vocabulary (H1..H15 plus documented named programmes). Null for genuinely non-hypothesis runs (see purpose).

also_informs.description: Secondary studies/hypotheses this run also feeds (the many-to-many tail; e.g. pv-diag-384 feeds H11, PV-strategy, N-sweep, Flash-vs-Pro). The precise membership is carried by analyses selecting conditions; this is the coarse navigational tag.

purpose.description: Free-text escape hatch for dev / debug / exploratory runs that do not map to a hypothesis.

run_type.description: Coarse architecture family. 'mixed' where the run's conditions span architectures (the precise architecture lives on each condition).

tile_size_px.description: The run's evaluation grid. Null ONLY where tile size is a factor the run varies across its own conditions, in which case each condition carries its own value and no single run-level figure is true; every fixed-geometry run must state its integer.

corpus.description: Which map sheets the run covers (e.g. 4-map-gs, 55-map, or a named subset). Constant across a run.

gt_reference.description: Which ground-truth reference the metrics are computed against. Constant across a run; matters for interpretation.

scope.description: Nominal/design-intent evaluation scope, shared by most conditions. A condition overrides via scope_override only when its as-evaluated tile set diverges (rare, ~2%).

headline_condition_id.description: HUMAN-designated foreign key to the condition that represents this run in the paper/leaderboard. NOT auto-computed — calling a condition 'best' over-claims when confidence intervals overlap. Usually the preregistered/canonical condition, or the simplest among a tied top set.

headline_rationale.description: Why that condition was designated headline; notes any statistical tie (the tie itself is recorded as an analysis with a tie_set).

post_run_report_path.description: Repository-relative path of the run's post_run_report.md; null if not yet authored.

working_notes_obs.description: Working-notes observations about this run, as 'Obs N — title'. NO line numbers (they drift).

historical_aliases.description: Prior names for cross-referencing existing prose, e.g. ['Era 2', 'the v2 GS run']. 'Era' is retired going forward but preserved here.

run.$comment: Lenient back-fill policy: identity (run_id, directory_path), grouping (primary_hypothesis — nullable), context (tile_size_px, corpus, gt_reference, scope), and provenance are required. Derived fields dates_run and total_cost_usd are intentionally ABSENT — they are computed on demand from passes (min/max timestamp; sum cost), not stored, to avoid a denormalisation the generator must keep in sync.
